address: 120 rue de la Croix-de-Seguey, Bordeaux, 33000, France
bio: A landmark of Bordeaux’ culinary scene for several decades now, this stone town house is emblematic of 18C Bordeaux. At the helm, chef Thomas Morel, whose wife Célia supervises the front of house, gives free rein to his creativity. Underpinned by a solid classical background, the food is dotted with contemporary notes, such as immaculately cooked pollock flanked by an astounding horseradish-flavoured hollandaise sauce. The lunchtime menu is particularly attractive....
